outcomes.outcome: the backup script carries the values of the Hiera keys puppet::basedir and the like, and root's crontab runs it at 23:00 every day
the backup directory the script writes into is there after the apply
a run writes a dated gzip tar of /etc/puppetlabs from which a file restores byte for byte
the run deletes the prefix's archives older than 9 full days and keeps newer ones and other prefixes' files

uncovered.why: a run would have to wait for 23:00; the crontab entry is checked and the script it names is run by hand
uncovered.lifted_by: capability: a clock-controlled cron trigger inside a phase3 run
uncovered.evidence: phase3.py runs probes and agent runs only; it has no step that advances or waits for the node's cron schedule
